papers.authors: Christian McDowell, Andrea Panebianco, Sirin Chakraborty, Yin Sun
papers.evidence: 在深度学习收发器中使用了变分信息瓶颈
papers.tldr: 现有语义通信多注重压缩与传输，缺乏对数据显著性的量化，也未联合优化物理层和MAC层。本文引入基于统计决策的每样本显著性度量，构建跨层优化框架：物理层提出Meta-VIB编码器，用元学习超网络自适应压缩语义特征；MAC层将信道分配建模为MA-RMAB，通过Q-Maximization算法按语义价值调度。在行人安全数据集上，联合设计在平均信噪比0dB和5dB时分别获得高达1000倍和40倍的语义频谱效率增益，展示了价值驱动通信的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study a significance-driven cross- layer semantic communication design problem. Based on sta- tistical decision theory, we introduce an information-theoretic measure of per-sample data significance that quantifies the task-specific value of each individual observation. Using this metric, we formulate a cross-layer optimization problem that simultaneously optimizes (i) physical-layer semantic encoding and inference and (ii) MAC-layer resource allocation, with the objective of maximizing semantic spectrum efficiency, defined as the semantic value delivered per unit bandwidth per unit time. At the physical layer, we develop Meta-Learning Variational Information Bottleneck (Meta-VIB), a new semantic transceiver that employs a meta-learned hypernetwork to compress high- dimensional observations into semantically significant latents, enabling instantaneous adaptation to dynamic channel conditions and varying symbol budgets without online retraining. At the MAC layer, we model channel allocation as a Multi-Action Restless Multi-Armed Bandit (MA-RMAB) and adopt the Q- Maximization algorithm, which dynamically allocates channel resources to sensors based on their semantic value of information. Experimental results on a real-world pedestrian safety dataset demonstrate that our joint design achieves substantial gains in semantic spectrum efficiency over baselines, reaching up to 1000 times gain at an average SNR of 0 dB and 40 times gain at an average SNR of 5 dB.
